in.rationale: Both records discuss debate judge accuracy. The authors say their observations, that the Guard's performance scales with general intelligence rating while Houdini performance stays constant, are consistent with prior work including Michael et al., which they describe as finding that judge accuracy may improve with using better models. Michael et al.'s cited figures give judge accuracy per condition (84% for human debate, 74% for human consultancy, and 78% and 80% for AI debate and consultancy), so they vary the condition rather than the judge's capability. text: Across 413 debates and consultancies, the paper reports human debate accuracy of 84% versus 74% for human consultancy (p = 0.04 by proportion test), with AI debate and consultancy between them at 78% and 80%. Judges beat chance in all settings, human debate falls 8.5 points short of an estimated 92.5% upper bound, and human-debate accuracy is 88% for judgments made with at least 95% confidence.
title: Judge accuracy: human debate 84%, human consultancy 74%, AI debate 78%, AI consultancy 80%
